title: Comte Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make rice bowl dish featuring Comte cheese and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Add 1 cup of rice and reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in 2 teaspoons of aromatic rice seasoning.
Transfer the cooked rice to a bowl and top with 1/2 cup of shredded Comte cheese.
